intro: Foreman Thistlenettle was once a dwarven overseer representing both the Miners' League and the Explorers' League within the depths of Westfall. After a catastrophic cave-in trapped his crew in the subterranean tunnels of the Deadmines, he perished alongside his workers and rose again as an undead ghoul. He now wanders the dark, collapsed corridors, unrecognizable to all except by the guild badge he still carries.
